name: 5-fluoro-AMT
summary: 5-Fluoro-αMT, also known as 5-fluoro-α-methyltryptamine (5F-AMT) or by its developmental code names PAL-212 and PAL-544, is a monoaminergic drug of the tryptamine and α-alkyltryptamine families related to α-methyltryptamine (αMT). It is taken orally.

pharmacology.text: 5-Fluoro-AMT has been found to act as a fairly balanced serotonin-norepinephrine-dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA), as a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist, and as a potent and specific MAO-A inhibitor. Its EC50 values in terms of monoamine release are 14 to 19 nM for serotonin, 78 to 126 nM for norepinephrine, and 32 to 37 nM for dopamine in rat brain synaptosomes.
